explication: Burrow is a system-maintenance and monitoring desktop app, with macOS as its mature native product and Windows preview implementations. The main user workflow is to choose a tool in the app, inspect a scan or preview, then run a cleanup, uninstall, purge, or maintenance action through the bundled engine; destructive operations are consent-gated. Separate capabilities include disk analysis, live status and metric history, and an MCP interface for AI agents. The graph combines README-documented capabilities with sampled engine, history, MCP, and helper relationships; unsampled feature internals are represented at their exact source paths, without inferred call chains.
